name: quadruped_statue
description: Parametric quadruped statue (四足雕像) with locked readable proportions — distinct legs, torso box, raised neck, head with snout, ears and tail. Accent material marks hooves/snout/ears/tail tip. Exists to end the 'abstract cow' failure mode: never freehand an animal, run this.
when_to_use: Any four-legged animal statue/figure (horse, cow, dog, deer...). Tune length for size, materials for species (e.g. white_concrete + calcite for a horse). origin = min corner of the bounding box at hoof-bottom level.

length.notes: nose-to-tail torso length; all other proportions derive from it
